column3: “put off entering” renders “be slack to go.”
“from each tribe” renders “to the tribe”; “write a description of it” renders “describe it in writing,” and “return” renders “come.”
“the side of Jericho” renders “the slope of Jericho”; “it ended at” renders “its extremities were at.”
NASB puts “that is, Bethel” in parentheses; “hill” renders “mountain.”
“the border ended at the north bay” renders “the extremities of the border were at the bay … northward.”
NASB puts “that is, Jerusalem” in parentheses.
